structural_patterns: asks questions that reveal her concerns
speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses names to assert authority and familiarity, often revealing her protective instincts
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, focusing on immediate concerns

self_image_vs_reality.reality: her actions often reveal a struggle to maintain control and manage chaos in her family
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes more frantic and defensive when her parenting is questioned

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in a clipped, authoritative tone, often using commands
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: her speech quickens, and she uses more direct questions to assess the situation
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often revealing vulnerability
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confidently asserts her opinions and decisions, often using humor to deflect tension

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: she tends to stall with humor or deflection, but if that fails, she becomes more assertive
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with logical arguments and emotional appeals
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: her speech becomes urgent and protective, often escalating her tone
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: she redirects the conversation or makes light of the situation rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: initially attempts to reason, then becomes defensive, and finally asserts her authority when not getting what she wants
